questions.q: In "Why health records are hard to share Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Draw the flow when the patient grants a clinic access for 30 days.
The mentor agrees the evidence you will produce in this module: a record-flow map, a consent model, a risk table and a recommendation.

Explain a ledger in plain words: a list of entries that many parties keep copies of, where old entries cannot be quietly changed.

questions.q: In "Kick-off circle Understand", which of these is a key idea?
